name: App Orchestrator
description: Root application orchestrator. Creates CanvasArea for the infinite card surface, TopBar for the menu system, and modal/overlay singletons (Welcome, About, Theme, AiDrawer, Tutorial). Handles workspace selection via WelcomeModal, save/restore of plugin state to .cockpit/window.json, keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+N for new window, Ctrl+W close tab, Ctrl+Tab cycle cards, Ctrl+P file search, Ctrl+J new terminal), theme persistence via prefs, and exposes the __cockpit global API consumed by the AI agent.

dependencies.usage: Creates TopBar menu bar with all plugin, zoom, and help callbacks
Creates CanvasArea as the card surface; delegates addTerminal/addExplorer/addGit/addMarkdown/addSpecsmap, autoArrange, zoom/pan, and plugin list management
Opens WelcomeModal on initial startup to select or open a workspace
Opens AboutModal from Help > About menu
Opens ThemeModal from Tools > Theme menu for base/mode selection
Toggles AiDrawer slide-out panel from Tools > AI menu
Starts Tutorial overlay from Help > Tutorial or on first launch
Loads/saves theme preferences via theme.setTheme/setDark and reads theme.themeName for persistence

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Loads theme pref, registers keyboard shortcuts, creates CanvasArea, TopBar, modals, then calls promptWorkspace()

methods.name: loadWorkspace
methods.description: Sets workspace path, registers __cockpit global, restores or creates default plugins, loads prefs and tutorial state

methods.name: registerCockpitGlobal
methods.description: Exposes __cockpit global API for agent tool calls (getCanvasState, addPlugin, focusCard, writeToTerminal, etc.)
